modalities.evidence: Resting state fMRI data acquired on a cohort of rats

output.population: A cohort of rats with intracerebroventricular injection of streptozotocin and a cohort of sham-injected controls; some rats are missing the last timepoint
output.summary: Resting-state fMRI in rats given intracerebroventricular streptozotocin to model Alzheimer's disease-like pathology and in sham-injected controls, scanned at four time-points to track resting-state network changes during pathology progression.
